_comment: The incumbent skill ranker's measured hit rate. Regenerate: ./scripts-run src/scripts/measure_skill_ranker_baseline --corpus routing-matrix --commit <sha>. The top-level top1/top3 are the POWERED reading over the 390-row labelled routing matrix. The 26-prompt row under `underpowered_rows` is kept because deleting it would lose the record of what was published, not because it may be quoted — it may not.

headline.denominator_note: tests/eval/routing-matrix/ rows whose expected_skills list is NON-EMPTY. A row with an empty list is a deliberate "no skill expectation" and is excluded from the denominator — never counted as a miss.

holdout._comment: The partition every Phase-2 lift claim is read on (sliceForId in measure_skill_ranker_baseline.ts: FNV-1a of the case id, modulus 5). The sealed arm is UNDERPOWERED at 75 rows, and that is a property of the instrument rather than of any ranker: see the null below.

underpowered_rows.may_not_be_quoted: This is the 0.615 figure published as the ranker precision before a powered corpus existed. Its 95 % interval is 35 points wide and does not overlap the powered reading in either column. It is retained as a record, not as a figure.

matrix_coverage.note: Coverage over EVERY matrix case, labelled or not: whether the ranker answers at all and how confident its top answer is. Accuracy over the labelled subset is the `accuracy` arm under `--corpus routing-matrix`. Size is measured here, never asserted: 496 and 499 are both published elsewhere and both stale.

history.note: Phase 3.1 recorded a NULL: no candidate configuration cleared the promotion bar, so the default is unchanged. The bar is the sealed slice's top-1 lower bound exceeding the baseline's upper bound (0.251); the best candidate (`idf`) reached a sealed lower bound of 0.104. See skill-ranker-confusion-2026-10-01.md for the configurations and the classes they could not separate.

premise_defects_found_by_this_step: The 26-prompt top-1 of 0.615 was published as this ranker’s precision in this file’s own top-level `top1` until 2026-10-01, while the precision report that produced it already said it may not be quoted. A headline figure a sibling artifact forbids quoting is a defect in the file, not in the reader.
